title: The noncommuting native port is supported, while new controller matrices remain required
statement: The targeted native review accepts the strict external-edge-majority idempotent payload, full-read basis permutation/reset, physical edge/prefix witnesses and full canonical-bit/history block algebra. The physical wrong-port projector need not commute with F_p: it is supported on a commuting bad sector R, so the read commutator is paid entirely by rooted bad-sector drift. A read-specific finite-cone comparison is uniform only along the explicit hierarchy t theta^(-k_cone)<<1; arbitrary DATA-Pauli noise constants are not theta-uniform. Keeping b=2lambda C_sparse allows fixed nominal rate scaling without losing the sparse vacuum ratio. Actual new finite controller matrices/dirty/useful/activity coefficients and quantitative native rooted drift still must be assembled; grouped-qudit two-site locality, native acquisition and full graph/reset/phase capture are not supplied.

requires: Specified strict external-edge majority and full canonical-bit/B-block algebra, DATA-free monitored private erasure and exact useful CP interpolation structure.
Actual finite read-cone supports/no-jump S_min and t theta^(-k_cone) hierarchy, retaining sparse-source/rate ratios.
Any use as a full native instance additionally requires the missing recomputed finite controller and dirty/useful/activity drift certificate.

Its same-envelope correction is essential; failed V1 remains history. Finite bounded-body majority/reset/copy primitives, bounded incidence, fixed favorable parameters and potentially enormous hardware/rates/constants are actual resources. A fixed-time port law is not an arbitrary adaptive temporal-noise law. Terminal physical-qubit readout, conditional quantum waiting/composition, signed quantum receiving and native port algebra have separate hypotheses below; no full external source/factory, qualified detector, native capture compilation, autonomous scheduler or dense-frame execution is inferred.
costs: Capture has O(log n) scheduled growth stages and O(n) record space/growth site-time; storage over physical horizon H also pays O(nH) site-time. Positive thresholds may be extremely small and fixed constants enormous.

Supplied instrument, raw acquisition, seed resets, external schedule and finite-strength atomic body gates are paid. Native grouped-qudit two-site algebra does not deliver native acquisition or all finite controller matrices.
